title: Counting to 10
short: Say the numbers to 10, and start from any number.

blocks.html: Now let’s count all the way to 10! After 5 come 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. You can also start from any number, like 4: 4, 5, 6.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Say each number as you point. Then try starting at 3.

blocks.title: Start at 4
blocks.q: Leo starts counting at 4. What comes next?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Count to 10 while you wash hands, wait for the bath to fill, or swing on a swing. Sometimes start from a number other than 1: “Let’s count from 6!” Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Count 10 pushes on the swing.
Count down the last 5 steps before the bottom.
